sections.content: Defending an opinion requires a clear position, a reason or evidence, acknowledgement of another view and a conclusion. This allows a learner to move beyond simply stating what they think.

items.spanish: Creo que la práctica es esencial porque permite aplicar lo aprendido.
items.english: I think practice is essential because it allows you to apply what you have learned.

items.spanish: Entiendo ese argumento, pero considero que la práctica ofrece una ventaja importante.
items.english: I understand that argument, but I consider practice to offer an important advantage.

items.spanish: Según mi experiencia, este método funciona mejor.
items.english: In my experience, this method works better.

sections.content: A defensible opinion normally includes a position, a reason or evidence, acknowledgement of another view and a conclusion.
